reuse.why: Routes category selection through the existing shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory and uses setBudget/getSheetValue/batchMessages, but re-derives the expense/income sign inline instead of calling the existing averageBudgetAmount helper.

duplication.why: Copies the categories+group_hidden SQL query used by setZero/set3MonthAvg and inlines the is_income sign flip that averageBudgetAmount already provides.

placement.why: New action sits in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the action, its handler registration/type, the MonthBudgetAction union member and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: Small and consistent with sibling actions; the inline sign rule and copied query are the only things a maintainer would have to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts setLastMonthSpending: `cat.is_income === 0 ? -spending : spending` instead of averageBudgetAmount(spending, cat.is_income)

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts setLastMonthSpending: the body of averageBudgetAmount is re-written inline with renamed variables (spending/cat.is_income)
